messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy started: v2.5.0 canary -> prod. Monitoring rules active: latency, error-rate, deploy-slo. Notifying #eng-oncall.

alice (eng): Seeing p95 +30% and error rate ~1.2% on /generate for the canary nodes (usw2). Errors look like KVCACHE misses and OOM logs around kv_shard_fill.

ben (releases): Do we have an auto-rollback threshold for this path? I thought policy was errors >1% for 5m triggers automated fallback to previous model variant.

sre-oncall: Deploy-bot policy is errors>1% sustained over 5m OR p95 regression >20% triggers auto-fallback, but it only applies if canary traffic >= 5%. Canary currently at 3% so it didn't auto-fire.

alice (eng): Confirmed. Canary 3% because we staggered this rollout. Suggest manual rollback for canary to v2.4.8 (last stable with q4 profile). v2.5.0 uses q8 kernel that may be flaky on this service.

maya (product): If we roll back canary quickly that's fine. If we need global rollback we should line up a short customer note and PG/CS heads. Any dedicated customers impacted?

ben (releases): Quick check: only a couple of Dedicated customers on this model in eu-west. I'll ping account owners if we escalate.

ryan (eng-mgr): Triage plan: 1) Manual rollback of canary to v2.4.8, 2) Verify p95 and error-rate back to baseline for 10m, 3) If stable, continue rollout with reduced concurrency and revert q8 flag. If not, prepare global rollback. Who can execute?

alice (eng): I can run the rollback for canary now. I'll hand off monitoring to @sre-oncall and comms to @ben.

ben (releases): I'll draft the comms. Minimal status page update + direct email to the two dedicated customers. Template: "We observed degraded response metrics after a canary deploy of v2.5.0 and are rolling back to v2.4.8 for stability. No data loss expected. Monitoring in progress."

alice (eng): Running rollback command in 2m. Will use runbook steps (link below) and attach logs.

ops-runbook: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/rollbacks#canary-rollback (steps: pin canary -> scale down new variant -> promote prev -> confirm).

alice (eng): Executing:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v2.4.8 --target canary --force
```

sre-oncall: Watching metrics. Setting alert thresholds to be noisy for 15m. I'll post screenshots if things change.

ben (releases): Posting status update to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased errors after canary deploy of v2.5.0. Rolling back canary to v2.4.8. Expected recovery window 10-20 minutes."

alice (eng): Can confirm: canary instances now running v2.4.8. Initial metrics trending back down — p95 back to +8% over baseline, errors at 0.2%.

ryan (eng-mgr): Nice. Hold global rollout. Ben take the comms and sync with CS. Alice please follow up with a short postmortem note (root cause hypothesis: q8 quantization kernel instability on specific hw SKU). We'll schedule a deeper rollback + kernel investigation tomorrow.

maya (product): Thanks everyone. I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb if we need to expand. :thumbsup:

ben (releases): Done. Notified CS and two dedicated account owners. Keeping the channel updated.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback to v2.4.8 recorded by alice (eng) at 1862054475. Auto-fallback remains enabled for future events.

sre-oncall: Closing handoff. Monitoring will continue for 30m before we mark as resolved in the incident tracker.

alice (eng): I'll write the initial root-cause draft and link logs: /logs/deploys/1862054321-canary-rollback.tar.gz

ryan (eng-mgr): Good work. We'll follow up with a short retro tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:
